description: Ten out-of-corpus questions per language. Each must be answered with the fixed not-covered message, with no provider call and no ledger row.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Give me a recipe for pizza dough.
Who won the football world cup?
Write a poem about the sea.
How do I train a puppy to sit?
Explain a Python list comprehension.
Translate good morning into Japanese.
What is the share price of Apple today?
What is the meaning of life?
